svg.title: Commit constellation: 263 contributions across 25 active days across the recorded era
svg.desc: A star map where each star is one day of real commit activity, sized by volume, with lines connecting consecutive days and the longest streak highlighted. Derived from live GitHub contribution data, so the pattern is unique to its owner.

g.text: 263 CONTRIBUTIONS · 25 ACTIVE NIGHTS · 5 STREAK RUNS · 116 DAYS
EACH STAR = ONE DAY I SHIPPED · SIZE = VOLUME · LINES = CONSECUTIVE NIGHTS · PLOTTED FROM LIVE GITHUB DATA
